shared_elements: bird with hooked beak seen in profile
repeated rows of similar small motifs (scale-like feathers in A / row of animal heads in B)
horizontal band of repeated pattern crossing the composition
raised relief modelling against a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces show a raptor-like profile head with a strongly hooked beak, plus horizontal banding and rows of repeated small units within a tall vertical field, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a single, bilaterally symmetrical frontal bird rendered as a smooth, outlined, brightly coloured metal plaque, while B is a weathered monochrome stone relief with several unrelated creatures stacked in registers and no symmetry.
